title: Photo to Bas-Relief STL: Which Photos Carve Well, and Which Never Will
excerpt: A relief made from a photo is only as good as the photo. Here is what the conversion actually does with your picture, the five things that make a portrait or pet photo carve cleanly, the four that ruin it before you start, and how to shoot one that works, whether you carve it on a router or print it flat on an FDM machine.
seo_title: Photo to Bas-Relief STL: Choosing a Source Image That Carves Well
seo_description: How a photo becomes a bas-relief STL, which portrait and pet photos carve cleanly on a CNC router or 3D printer, the lighting and angle that work, and the four things that ruin a source image before you start.

email.subject: Which photos carve well? The five things that decide it
email.intro:
Most of the custom design requests we get start with a photo taken on a phone in a kitchen. Some of those become beautiful reliefs. Some cannot, and the difference is decided before anyone opens a modelling tool.

The new guide explains what the conversion really does with your picture, the five things that make a portrait or a pet photo carve cleanly, the four that ruin it, and how to take one that works in ten minutes with a window and a plain wall.
